description: For countable structures \(M,N\) in the same language, every map in a back-and-forth system extends to an isomorphism from \(M\) onto \(N\). The language need not be countable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.BackAndForth.countable_isomorphism.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] [Countable M] [Countable N]
  (S : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.BackAndForth.BackForthSystem L M N)
  (p₀ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso L M N) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ S.maps) :
  ∃ e, ∀ (a : ↑p₀.dom), e ↑a = p₀.toFun a
